cand.title: Club Med Punta Cana — January 2027 Pickleball Vacation
cand.excerpt: High evidence and exact competitor commitment; current accessibility is none, so value is future capture/overflow intelligence rather than open current demand.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Oto Hlincik, co-founder and CEO of Royal Pickleball and a listed edition instructor, is the strongest executive account-development contact. Joel Wolf, listed PPR-certified pro instructor, is a verified programme stakeholder suitable for sports-operational fit discussions and an introduction to the sourcing lead. Neither is publicly identified as the hotel contract signatory; Wolf should not be labeled a verified accommodation buyer.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed advertised activity dates: January 19–24, 2027, Punta Cana, Dominican Republic. The edition heading and arrival/departure instructions independently specify these activity dates; they are not article publication dates. Within the requested horizon. No subsequent Punta Cana edition through May 2028 was found.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel profile: Wyndham Alltra’s all-inclusive, guestroom-led resort product is conceptually aligned with this coached leisure/sports vacation; a city conference hotel is not the evident format. Meeting-room capacity is not the key qualification test. The organizer promises permanent pickleball courts, 8+ coaching hours and an 8:1 player-to-instructor ratio. Wyndham’s reviewed official amenities page does not verify permanent pickleball courts or reserved clinic capacity. Do not assume basketball/volleyball space, tennis courts or meeting space can substitute. Court suitability must be resolved before a competitive proposal.
findings.venueCommitments: Club Med Punta Cana is explicitly committed in the organizer’s edition-specific offer for both accommodation and on-property permanent-court pickleball activities. Named accommodations are Family Superior Room - Renovated and Zen Oasis, Junior Suite - Garden. This is stronger than a preferred-hotel listing. Evidence establishes a marketed lodging-and-activity package, not a disclosed executed hotel contract, guaranteed room block, allotment size or exclusive court buyout.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified programme precedent: January 13–18, 2026 at Club Med Turkoise, Turks and Caicos. Upcoming programme trips are January 19–24, 2027 at Club Med Punta Cana and February 1–6, 2027 at Club Med Turkoise. This establishes repeated Royal Pickleball resort vacations across two destinations, including repeat Turkoise use; it does not establish an annually rotating single event or annual Punta Cana recurrence. No earlier Punta Cana edition was located.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Accommodation is bundled into Royal Pickleball’s double-occupancy vacation package, with organizer-collected deposits and an organizer support address. Meals, drinks, coaching and airport transfers are included. Hotel selection is already announced; no open hotel RFP or alternative lodging sourcing was found. The edition page says the trip is currently at capacity. Actual block terms, contracting entity and any intermediary remain undisclosed.
findings.organizationStructure: Royal Pickleball presents a commercial pickleball gear and experiences business, not a membership association conference owner. Its terms identify Royal Pickleball as the website operator; the event page markets the vacation and names its co-founder/CEO. Club Med Punta Cana is the host resort, not the event owner. No separate PCO, DMC, travel agency or licensed travel contracting entity was identified in the reviewed edition materials.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Incumbent advantage is an integrated Club Med lodging, food-and-beverage and permanent-court product; both published 2027 vacations use Club Med resorts. The Punta Cana page says the trip is at capacity and marks the standard room category sold out, but publishes no attendance, peak rooms or block size. Capacity does not prove resort-wide sellout, displaced guestrooms, court exclusivity or external overflow demand. The page also has inconsistent standard-package prices and balance deadlines between its booking summary and body; do not use these as reliable commercial terms.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Royal Pickleball through the edition’s published support@royalpickleball.com address, requesting an introduction to Oto Hlincik for a future-departure supplier discussion, not displacement of January 2027. Ask who sources/contracts hotels, whether non-Club Med resorts are eligible, the next decision window and required court access. In parallel, verify Alltra’s playable permanent-court capacity and clinic reservations internally. If both gates pass, arrange a focused resort-and-court inspection with Oto and programme input from Joel Wolf; obtain actual room demand before quoting. Do not pitch speculative overflow.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the January 2027 edition, lodging and activities are committed to Club Med Punta Cana, with the trip advertised at capacity. No verified Wyndham Alltra room, meeting or overflow opportunity exists. Treat hotel sourcing as committed elsewhere, not open; undisclosed legal exclusivity is not a basis to claim an absolute contractual prohibition on changes.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: the verified multi-trip resort programme supports executive relationship development for a later or additional Punta Cana departure. No uncommitted 2028 Punta Cana edition or competitive hotel-selection window was verified. February 2027 Turkoise is already committed and outside this hotel’s territory, so it is programme intelligence rather than local demand. Future capture is conditional on organizer interest in a non-Club Med property and a credible permanent-court solution.
